第62章 紫萱易主，早餐硝烟-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

“导演对试妆不满意？”

“对。”

回到酒店，糖嫣马上给纪如璟打电话询问解决办法。

她入行没几年，第一次碰到这种情况，整个人都慌了。

“璟姐，剧组不会真的换掉我吧？”

为了饰演这个角色，她没少下功夫，光人物小传就写了好几千字。

从里到外把唐雪见这个角色分析个遍。

现在就因为导演对定妆照不满意，就要把我换了，凭什么啊！！

电话另一头，纪如璟眼睛微微眯起。

直觉告诉她，这件事情没这么简单，一定还有猫腻。

只是她还不知道为什么...

她和李国立打过交道，对方是一个优秀的导演，同样是一个人精。

试妆不满意为什么不早点说，临到进组了才说这些？

这不是欺负老实人嘛！！

“你先不要轻举妄动，等我消息。如果他们真要换掉你，我会给你争取补偿。”

“好...”

糖嫣咬牙挂断电话。

听经纪人的意思，换角色的可能性很大，让她有个心理准备。

与此同时，作为一对换角苦命鸳鸯，刘施施心里更加崩溃。

她喜欢紫萱这个角色，为此付出的努力不比糖嫣少。

“呜呜呜，你不是说我是未来一姐嘛？哪有这样对自家一姐的？”

这孩子在魏沐怀里暴风哭泣，从进门开始就是这样，一直到现在...

给魏老板整无语了，你是真不怕被我的粉丝围攻啊。

双手捧起瞎姐的俏脸，给她擦了擦脸上的泪水。

“放心，老蔡舍弃谁，也不会舍弃你。你可是未来唐人之星”

“真的？那我的紫萱不会被换掉啦？”

刘施施闻言一喜，眸子中多了几分神采。

“额.......”

停顿几秒，见对方没有反应，瞎姐又开始哭。

“呜呜呜，我就知道你在安慰我，紫萱肯定要给别人。”

魏沐没有解释，而是掏出手机打开论坛，给她看网上的贴子。

“公司之前释放定妆照，你有没有关注过网上的反应。”

刘施施不情不愿的说：“看过，好多人骂我，还有老胡，只有你被夸。”

作为一名网瘾少女，刘施施早就看了这些评论。

面对网上一群喷子，她倒是没有很在意，毕竟她自己就是一个大喷子，经常跟人对线。

"The director is not satisfied with the makeup test?"

"Yes."

Back at the hotel, Tang Yan immediately called Ji Rujing to ask for a solution.

She had only been in the industry for a few years, and when she encountered this situation for the first time, she panicked.

"Sister Jing, the crew won't really replace me, right?"

In order to play this role, she worked hard and wrote several thousand words in the character biography alone.

Analyze the character Tang Xuejian from the inside out.

Now just because the director is not satisfied with the makeup photos, he wants to replace me. Why?!

On the other end of the phone, Ji Rujing narrowed her eyes slightly.

Her intuition told her that this matter was not that simple, and there must be something fishy about it.

But she doesn't know why yet...

She has dealt with Li Guoli, who is an excellent director and also a good person.

Why didn't you tell me earlier if you were not satisfied with the makeup test, and then only said this when you joined the group?

Isn’t this bullying an honest person?!

"Don't act rashly first and wait for my news. If they really want to replace you, I will seek compensation for you."

"Okay..."

Tang Yan gritted her teeth and hung up the phone.

According to her agent, there is a high possibility of changing roles, so she should be mentally prepared.

At the same time, as a pair of desperate mandarin ducks exchanging roles, Liu Shishi felt even more broken.

She likes the role of Zixuan and has put in as much effort as Tang Yan for it.

"Uuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuancyuu, didn't you say that I am the future first sister? How could you treat your own first sister like this?"

The child was crying violently in Wei Mu's arms. He had been like this since he entered the house, and it has been like this until now...

Boss Wei is speechless. You are really not afraid of being attacked by my fans.

He held the blind sister's pretty face with both hands and wiped the tears from her face.

"Don't worry, Lao Cai will never abandon you no matter who he abandons. You are the future star of Tang Dynasty."

"Really? Then my Zixuan won't be replaced?"

Liu Shishi was overjoyed when he heard this, and his eyes became a little brighter.

"Um..."

After a pause for a few seconds and seeing no response from the other party, the blind sister started crying again.

"Ooooo, I knew you were comforting me. Zixuan must give it to someone else."

Wei Mu didn't explain, but took out his phone and opened the forum and showed her the online posts.

"The company released the final makeup photos before. Have you paid attention to the reaction online?"

Liu Shishi said reluctantly: "I've seen that many people scolded me and Lao Hu, but you were the only one praised."

As an Internet-addicted girl, Liu Shishi has long read these comments.

Facing a group of trolls on the Internet, she didn't pay much attention. After all, she is a big troll herself and often confronts people.
